faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag Recruitment 2026 is 25 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Para Cook and Para Helper posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies announced by Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag. Out of these, 2 vacancies are for the Para Cook post and 4 vacancies are for the Para Helper post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Para Cook?
faq.answer: For the Para Cook position, candidates must have completed Matriculation from a recognized board and possess a Degree/diploma in Hotel Management/Food Production or have at least 5 years of experience in cooking/catering.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Para Cook and Para Helper posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for both Para Cook and Para Helper posts is between 18 years to 45 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 9000/- for the Para Cook post and Rs. 5500/- for the Para Helper post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Para Cook and Para Helper posts?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates will be based on their performance in the Merit Basis and a Skill Test.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag, which is https://jsv.hp.nic.in/.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates along with the application form.
